lines.text: All inspection records must sync directly into our CRM accounts.
Our standard CRM connector synchronizes accounts, contacts, and work orders.
We will have the standard CRM sync connector live within twenty-one days.
We also need our lead technicians trained on compliance logging.
We will provide two sessions of admin training in the first week.
Can we have custom inspection certificates rendered automatically?
In theory we can build custom dashboards, but let me confirm the effort.
We will send over our CRM API credentials and test tenant access tomorrow.
